reasoning: This commit introduced the `isMounted` AtomicBoolean and the buggy `shutdown()` logic where `isMounted.set(NativeMethods.DokanRemoveMountPoint(...))` sets isMounted to true when unmount succeeds instead of false, causing "already unmounted" checks to misbehave (unable to unmount / wrong isMounted state).
